description: This file contains an interrupt service routine (ISR) written in ARM assembly language for handling the MCI (MultiMedia Card Interface) interrupt on AT91 microcontrollers. It includes context saving/restoring, handler invocation, and interrupt acknowledgment sequences.

methods.name: AT91F_ASM_MCI_Handler
methods.description: Assembly interrupt handler for MCI interrupts, saving context, calling C handler, and restoring context.
